verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharasan dhekhan naamadhev bhalake uTh tiralochan aavai|

en.bdb: Trilochan awoke early daily just to have sight of Namdev,

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਇ ਜਣੇ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat karan mil dhui jane naamadheau har chalit sunaavai|

en.bdb: Together they would concentrate on the Lord and Namdev would tell him the grand stories of God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: meree bhee kar benatee dharasan dhekhaa(n) je tis bhaavai|

en.bdb: (Trilochan asked Namdev) “kindly pray for me so that if the Lord accepts, I may also have a glimpse of His blessed vision.”

verses.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿਓਸੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: Thaakur jee no puchhios dharasan kivai tiralochan paavai|

en.bdb: Namdev asked Thakur, the Lord, as to how Trilochan could have sight of the Lord ?

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨੋ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: has kai Thaakur boliaa naamadheau no keh samajhaavai|

en.bdb: The Lord God smiled and explained to Naamdev;

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਭੇਟੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਮੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hath na aavai bheT so tus tiralochan mai muh laavai|

en.bdb: “No offerings are needed by me.  Out of my delight only, I would make Trilochan to have sight of me. "

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅਧੀਨੁ ਹਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਦੇ ਪਹੁੰਚਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਾਂ ਭਗਤੀ ਦਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau adheen haa(n) bhagat dhe pahu(n)ch na ha(n)ghaa(n) bhagatee dhaavai|

en.bdb: I am under the total control of the devotees and their loving claims I can never reject; rather I myself also cannot understand them.
Their loving devotion, in fact, becomes mediator and makes them meet me.”
